Name: Daily Screenshot
Author: CompSciLauren
TagLine: Automatically takes a screenshot of your entire farm when you exit your house for the first time each day.
Description:
![](https://i.postimg.cc/fy2JD15h/example-farm.gif)

This is an example of what you can do with this mod. You can customize the quality and size. By taking a daily screenshot, eventually you'll have enough images to create a GIF that shows a time-lapse of your farm as you progress through the game!

**Features**

*   One screenshot is automatically taken of your entire farm every day as soon as you leave your house.

*   Easy to gather screenshots to create a GIF that shows how your farm changes over time! GIF makers can be found online, such as [ezgif GIF maker](https://ezgif.com/maker). Here is an [example](https://github.com/CompSciLauren/stardew-valley-daily-screenshot-mod/blob/3.1.0/Images/example1.gif).

*   Customizable! Change any number of default settings based on your preferences. Examples:

    *   What time of day to take screenshot.

    *   How often to take screenshot (e.g. daily, weekly, or monthly).

    *   Keyboard shortcut that takes screenshot when pressed (set to "None" by default).

    *   What weather conditions are allowed. It is common to allow all except rainy/stormy days, but default option allows all weather.

    *   Add multiple sets of rules (common example: 1 set for daily automatic screenshots, 1 for manual key-press screenshots).

*   Compatible with the ["Generic Mod Config Menu" mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098), which adds an in-game UI for easily updating the config (no need to edit the JSON manually).

*   Screenshots are sent to your StardewValley/Screenshots folder, with each save file getting its own "FarmName-Screenshots" folder. Screenshots between multiple save files will not get mixed up.

*   Easily access the screenshots in-game by scrolling to the bottom of the "Options" tab in the menu and clicking the "Open Destination Folder" button.

*   Keeps the screenshots in the correct order to make creating the GIF easier. This is achieved by naming each screenshot with a "year-season-day.png" numerical format. For example, on Year 1, Winter, Day 3, the screenshot would be named "01-04-03.png".

*   Translations available for the following languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Chinese. Korean coming soon. All text will be translated if your in-game language is set to any of those listed.

**Installation**

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  Download [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098) and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods. (recommended, but optional)

3.  Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

4.  Run the game using SMAPI.
**Compatibility**

*   Works with Stardew Valley 1.4 or later on Linux/Mac/Windows

*   Does NOT work anymore on Android (see Android download option in Files tab under Miscellaneous). This is something I hope to fix eventually but is not being worked on currently.

*   Works in both single player and multiplayer.

*   No known mod conflicts.

*   Works with the [Generic Mod Config Menu](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098).
**Config**
See step 2 of "Installation" section above - highly recommend using the Generic Mod Config Menu! This will let you edit the mod settings from within the game on a user-friendly screen. If you'd rather edit the JSON directly, continue reading this section.

After you launch the game with this mod for the first time, a JSON file will be created with default mod settings. It can be edited directly. For detailed information about how the Config options work, see the [source code](https://github.com/CompSciLauren/stardew-valley-daily-screenshot-mod)  readme page. If you still have questions after reading that, please let me know! (You can post a comment on this mod page or message me on Discord - username is "compscilauren").

This is a common example of how you might setup your config.json file. The first object in "SnapshotRules" is for a daily screenshot of your farm at the start of each day. The second object is for a manual shortcut to take a screenshot every time you press the letter "P" on your keyboard.

More examples of customizing the config.json file are available on the [GitHub Wiki](https://github.com/CompSciLauren/stardew-valley-daily-screenshot-mod/wiki/Examples-for-config.json-file).

**Future**
To get a sneak peek of potential new features, see the [Mod Issues](https://github.com/CompSciLauren/stardew-valley-daily-screenshot-mod/issues) page.

If you have a feature request or run into a bug, please let me know! I do my best to review and address requests/reports when I can. This mod is a passion project I work on in my spare time, so updates may take a bit. Thank you for your patience. And thanks for checking out this mod!
